qualification_limits: Saved provenance resolution covers faces, edges and vertices; entirely overlapping independent solid references are not qualified by these tests.
Repeated coincident App::Links sharing the exact same TShape and placement are not qualified as separate indexed topology; the link regression uses distinct placements.
The existing geometric-equality predicate itself is unchanged; external references must match uniquely under that existing predicate.
Distinct mesh element groups do not establish independent coincident node ownership, a physical joint idealization, loading, stiffness or solver force correctness.
